title: pump operation
description: Incompressible-liquid pump. Given the shaft power and efficiency, the discharge pressure P_in + eta·W_shaft/(F·v_molar) and the small dissipation temperature rise follow from the energy balance.

W_shaft.title: Shaft power
W_shaft.description: Mechanical power delivered to the liquid (positive). One of W_shaft / P_out / dP fixes the duty. It may also arrive over an ENERGY WIRE instead of being written here: a consumer declaring `energyInputs ( { from <unit>.<port>; kind <work|heat>; target <key>; } )` has the value written into its operation block before solve, and the unit reads it exactly as if the author had typed it.  That is why this key is not marked required — the schema describes what an AUTHOR writes, and a wired value is not authored.

eta.title: Pump efficiency
eta.description: Hydraulic and mechanical efficiency, useful v·dP work / shaft work (0 < eta <= 1). The (1-eta) fraction heats the liquid.

P_out.title: Discharge pressure
P_out.description: Specify the outlet pressure instead of the power; the shaft work follows from v·dP/eta.

dP.title: Pressure rise
dP.description: Specify the rise instead of the outlet pressure or the power.

efficiency.title: Estimated efficiency (generic pump, C441)
efficiency.description: Instead of `eta`: the efficiency of a well-designed single-stage radial pump of this duty, Gulich Eq. T3.9.1 (p. 163). Needs `selection` and P_out or dP; every number is printed `estimated`.

selection.title: Generic pump selection (C441)
selection.description: speed (rpm); EXACTLY ONE of impeller <class> (Table D6.1, p. 320: standardAxialInlet, suctionImpellerAxial, betweenBearings, highPressure, inducer) or suctionSpecificSpeed <nss>; optional Qbep (best-efficiency flow) and preferredRange ( low high ) of Q/Qbep. The run prints nq, the efficiency, NPSH3, NPSHA, the margin and the operating region, each marked estimated.

suction.title: Suction conditions for the NPSH available (C441)
suction.description: staticHead (z_e, level above the pump axis, negative for a lift), lineLoss (H_v,s), inletVelocity (c_e); each defaults to zero and the run prints the value used (Gulich Eq. T2.2.8, p. 52).

curve.title: The maker's pump curve (C441, level 2)
curve.description: Name of constant/experiments/<name>.dat, a record of property pumpCurve with columns Q, H, eta, NPSHr. The pump sits on its curve (head, efficiency and NPSHr read at the feed's flow); W_shaft, P_out, dP and eta are refused beside it; a flow outside the curve is refused by name.
